portability_change: Environment roots discovered from user/site configuration
Missing profiles are created in isolated prefixes from versioned specs
Built-in task adapters enforce run-scoped outputs, stage environments, signatures, and completion evidence
Sample manifest and annotation-signature guard replace project labels
Samples, paths, thresholds, executables, and resources are injected
Genome, inputs, outputs, environments, and cell count are injected
VMR source, run signature, genome resources, and targets are injected
Pooled DMR source and baseline VMR inputs are injected
Shared environment variables use the neutral SCMO namespace
Standalone stage wrappers resolve resources from named scheduler profiles; no site directive or absolute path

New: the single scmo_submit helper that every standalone submit_*.sh uses to build its sbatch command line
Route runners acknowledge a non-DAG run explicitly and locate the project root from their own path instead of requiring a site absolute path
Route layout and defaults declared once; model ladder validated against configured lists instead of a hardcoded case
Outputs stripped, paths and kernelspec washed, sample labels and reviewed mapping kept as a labelled example

source_scope: Project parameters (roots, samples, thresholds, genome, counts)
portability_change: Real study values kept as an example intake and manifest; never read by a generated project
Full bilingual port with site paths abstracted and concrete evidence shown as labelled placeholders

New: the root README is rendered once from the intake and resolved configuration, and the root Report accumulates one concise record per run in a tool-owned SCMO-RUNLOG region that inspect_run.py refreshes and update_report.py rebuilds

source_scope: (source reviewed cluster mapping kept as notebook literals)
portability_change: New: turns one run's published clusters into a reviewer worksheet and records the reviewed result as the guarded annotation profile, binding that run's analysis signature and exact cluster set; the source project carried its reviewed mapping inside the notebook, which cannot be checked against a later run

source_scope: Data/ (hand-made symlink to another group's storage)
portability_change: New: the intake declares where each input already lives and generation links it to Data/<name>, so the convention the source project arrived at by hand is produced by the generator and recorded in project.yaml, the root README, and the root Report; a url source is fetched by the tool against a declared sha256 instead of being left to the operator

New packaged defaults: public hg38 reference files every methylation project needs and none should have to hunt for. Applied only to a human project with a methylation route and an hg38 genome; a project on another genome keeps the preflight failure instead of silently inheriting wrong coordinates
Deliberately excluded: no packaged stage reads a TSS bed, so shipping 2.8 MB of it would present an unused reference as a default. references.tss_bed stays optional and unset

Deliberately excluded: one study's site environment inventory and its reviewed cell-type labels. Shipping the first would carry another user's absolute interpreter paths; shipping either of the others would apply one study's annotation to the next project, which is the thing the annotation guard exists to prevent
